mensaje_crack.asunto: Your dispatchers and the carrier inbox
mensaje_crack.cuerpo:
Hi Maya,

Your post about dispatchers spending half the morning in carrier emails stuck with me. We just mapped the same problem for a 60-person freight firm: five carrier types created most of the back-and-forth, and an assistant now drafts those replies for a human to approve.

Would a 20-minute call next week be useful? I can show you the before-and-after, no pitch deck.

Pablo
ficha: COO at Harbor & Pine Logistics since 2023; came up through dispatch.
Public post on 15 Oct about carrier email overload; 140 reactions.
Same pain as the Atlas Freight pilot; lead with the dispatcher hours, not the tech.

mensaje_crack.asunto: Before you hire the second coordinator
mensaje_crack.cuerpo:
Hi Jordan,

Saw you're hiring a second ops coordinator. Before you do: in two small logistics teams we've worked with, a third of that role was re-typing the same temperature logs and delivery confirmations. That part can run on its own, and the person you hire gets to do the judgment work.

Worth 15 minutes to see if that holds for you?

Pablo

Job post for an operations coordinator, opened 18 Oct.
